status: FROZEN: development calibration and paper OOD confirmation are separate results
purpose: Evaluate whether a support-only learned relationship searcher recovers complete molecular, morphology, and spatial variable sets from measured HEST tissue data when the response contains a calibrated relation. This is not an expression simulator and not evidence of label-free biological discovery.

substrate.source: HEST paired H&E and measured spatial transcriptomics
substrate.response: a patient-disjoint ridge residual of a measured target after the declared B3 comparison ladder
substrate.candidate_variables: measured genes and frozen programme/foundation-model coordinates with own, nbr6, nbr18, and contrast transforms
prohibited: planted truth supplied to a method
held-out patient rows in proposal or fitting

family_contract.boolean: AND and XOR use per-patient median gates and are residualised against flexible proper-subset functions, so marginal signals are not a shortcut.
family_contract.residualised_3: A three-variable real-substrate relation is residualised against all single and pairwise flexible lower-order bases.
family_contract.context_and_spatial: Context and spatial relations use fixed within-sample k-nearest-neighbour transforms of measured variables.
family_contract.unseen_function: GP and piecewise functions are held out from meta-training; spatial_mix_gp combines an own value with a neighbor value.

worlds.calibration: variance(signal)/variance(residual) per world, recorded both overall and in support/query patients

partitions.development: kidney-injury only; may select implementation but can never support an OOD headline
partitions.primary_ood: leave the entire bladder study out of concept fitting, learned-search meta-training, normalisation fitting, and architecture selection; evaluate the frozen model on bladder
partitions.secondary_platform_ood: leave all st_100um studies out of concept fitting and learned-search meta-training; evaluate them only after primary OOD is sealed

methods.ablation: same architecture trained with row-split support/query episodes
methods.expressibility: A method that cannot represent the truth object is reported not-expressible, never counted as a MORPHEUS win.

endpoints.primary: complete variable-and-transform set recovery at top 16, with paired family/fraction-stratified world bootstrap confidence intervals
secondary: held-out higher-order gain versus the strongest flexible proper-subset decomposition
endpoints.reporting: Primary comparisons use BH correction across the predeclared method contrasts. Oracle scores are diagnostics only.

advance_rule: A method claim requires the bladder OOD comparison, not development: lower 95% paired confidence bound > 0.05 over row-split at top 16, >=0.10 absolute recovery advantage, no false-share worsening >0.05, and benefit in at least two difficult groups among AND/XOR, residualised triple, context, and spatial. A miss triggers one targeted N+1 engineering diagnosis; it does not redefine the protocol.
